titular: Java Backend Engineer | Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs · Oracle | Financial Sector
resumen: Java backend engineer with 5+ years building critical, high-volume systems for the financial sector in Colombia. I work with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux, microservices, and Oracle/PL-SQL, using hexagonal architecture, SOLID, and tests. I built the system that generates and sends encrypted monthly statements. I also delivered REST services, OTP/2FA for three transactional portals, and e-invoicing for DIAN. I handle the full cycle: requirements, design, code, tests, and deployment.
